source.title: Bottom-Up Copper Filling of Large Scale Through Silicon Vias for MEMS Technology

conditions.bath: 1.25 mol/L CuSO4 + 0.25 mol/L CH3SO3H (MSA) + 1 mmol/L KCl + variable Tetronic 701 (1-50 umol/L)
conditions.hydrodynamics: helicopter-blade rotation 400 rpm; vias ~2.5 cm from spindle axis -> ~100 cm/s tangential at via; FLUENT lid-driven cavity: vortices in upper 1/3, nearly stationary in lower 2/3
conditions.vias: 125 um dia nominal x 600 um deep (AR~5), ALD Pt seed, over-etched notched bottoms, 100 vias per 2x1 cm sample, pitch 250 um
conditions.prewet: -18 C IPA + rough vacuum ~10 min, direct transfer, 1-2 min open-circuit rotation

series.morphology: flat growth front, uniform between vias
series.tag: [C] height digitised from stated 100 um/h rate x time; figure not directly measured

data.growth_rate: nearly 100 um/h ~ local j approaching 75 mA/cm2

points.outcome: void-free (caveat: may be sectioning artifact near notch)

data.measurement: suppression breakdown / repassivation window on Pt RDE 400 rpm, 50 umol/L TET
data.note: ohmic slope ~3 ohm*cm2 at ~0.1 A/cm2 -> ~300 mV deviation

data.outcome: complete fill, some internal voiding in several vias
central seam void in every via (conformal deposition)

notes: Primary validation series for via-fill model (KB already cites ~6 h at -0.64 V). NOTE: fill heights at 2 h and 4 h are [C] from the stated 100 um/h rate, not measured off Fig 6; for rigorous validation digitise their Fig 6 (est. error +-20 um on 600 um via, i.e. +-3%). Local current density 75 mA/cm2 at bottom is the experimental anchor for bottom j during S-NDR fill at 400 rpm.
